jace: Bullets of Fury arcade sprite animation asset, using the attached orange/red stolen helix nova energy ball as the exact approved visual reference. Generate a proper full sprite sheet of 32 different smoothly progressing hand-drawn animation poses in a STRICT 4 columns by 8 rows grid, row-major. Every cell is exactly the same square size, all 32 energy balls have the EXACT same circular silhouette diameter, center and fixed pivot, perfectly onion registered, no drift, no translation, no camera change, no perspective change, no scale change, no growing/shrinking. Animate only surface energy: orange-red molten plasma plates flow around the spherical ball, white-hot cracks and fast two intertwined helix bands spiral over its surface, sharp electrified red/orange highlights move smoothly frame to frame. Preserve the original ball's bold red/orange/white palette and black molten crevices. The final frame joins the first in a smooth looping sphere with many real drawn intermediate frames. Each ball fits well within its equal square cell with 12% transparent margins. HD Neo-Geo arcade craftsmanship: crisp intentional pixel clusters, richly shaded molten cells, sharp outlines, detailed lightning at the edge. NO opaque backdrop, no checkerboard baked in, no ship, no labels, no captions, no UI, no lines between cells, no floor or cast shadow. Transparent background everywhere outside the spheres. The 32 frames must remain identical in position and silhouette; animation is the energy flowing over a fixed orb, NOT a bouncing or wobbling orb. Requested sheet 1024x2048, square 256x256 cells.
fire: Bullets of Fury HD Neo-Geo arcade FIRE LASER spritesheet, derived from the attached approved orange-red/white furnace laser. Generate 32 DISTINCT smooth looping hand-drawn intermediate animation poses in a STRICT 4 columns by 8 rows grid, row-major. Equal SQUARE cells, precisely registered. Each cell shows the same vertical narrow laser segment centered horizontally, always pointing straight UP, white-hot solid core, golden inner flame, orange and crimson sharp flame edges. The beam has a consistent width and straight center in all cells: only flowing plasma tongues and sparks move up the fixed column. Each square cell: beam from normalized x=.34 to .66, y=.12 to .78; a richly detailed symmetrical bright firing muzzle flare is seated at x=.50 y=.88, attached to the beam, occupying x=.28 to .72 and y=.78 to .97. The muzzle remains at that SAME physical point in all 32 cells. Keep beam center fixed; no wobble, no drifting, no growth or scale change. Make the animated flowing flames exceptionally detailed with intentional crisp small pixel clusters, sharp metallic arcade shading, HD Neo-Geo / Metal Slug explosion craft, not chunky low resolution. No ship or person or weapon body. No text, labels, counters, grid lines or checkerboard. Genuine transparent RGBA background outside the fire. Do not merge neighboring frames. Thirty-two different frames and a smooth last-to-first loop. Requested overall 1024x2048, equal 256x256 cells. The core must connect vertically across the full beam region so we can tile the cropped beam along a continuous damaging laser, separately draw its firing flare, and use both with the exact existing boss cannon emitters.
